metadata.description: P4: plugins that keep Claude Code's memory, notebook and temp files in the repo, each in its own directory under .claude/p4/, and recall the repo's own history next to each message; the design is .docs/p4/fresh-marketplace.md.

plugins.name: p4-temportal
plugins.description: Keeps every file Claude Code would otherwise write under AppData or the system temp directory in <project>/.claude/p4/temportal/: the memory, the notebook, each session's scratchpad and saved code. Files get lifetimes like a browser's cache and cookies, and what has expired is cleared. Replaces p4-memory and p4-scratchpad.

plugins.name: p4-recall
plugins.description: A small ranker trained on the repo's own store, kept in <project>/.claude/p4/recall/: adds a few lines from the owner's history next to a message when it is confident, and nothing otherwise.

plugins.name: p4-phi
plugins.description: What linked sessions hand each other, in the app's own words: every session starts with the store's rules, a started session is given the tasks and notes of the sessions above it, every finished turn's report reaches the session that started it in full, and a message about something else gets a forked session while this one stays with its task.
